programs.title: Perfect Wedding
programs.desc: Forced to work together, a wedding planner and an event planner learn that opposites can produce the most unexpected results.

programs.title: The Trouble With Spies
programs.desc: British spy George Trent goes missing in Ibiza. Appleton Porter heads over to look into it, chatting with folks staying at the hotel who were Trent's neighbors. Trent dodges a few murder attempts as he figures out what's going on.

programs.title: Tim
programs.desc: A 20-year-old guy with some learning difficulties has a job as a laborer, but people take advantage of his innocence. A kind 40-year-old American woman hires him and they become good friends. However, the townspeople and his family view her as someone with bad intentions.

programs.title: The Great Ghost Rescue
programs.desc: Young Humphrey is a ghost with a big problem. He and his family, the Craggyfords, have been ousted from their home and left without a place to haunt. As they search for new haunting grounds they soon discover that they are not alone.

programs.title: Baby Obsession
programs.desc: Anna Gray is pregnant and ready to start a family with her loving husband Jon. But she has no idea that Rachel, the mother of a baby who died from SIDS when Anna babysat her years ago, has been waiting for this day, determined to take back what Anna 'took from me'.

programs.title: Kill Thy Neighbour
programs.desc: When Julie’s husband dies, she moves cross-country to rebuild her life with son Matty and build a closer relationship with her late husband’s sister, Alison. Yet Alison blames Julie for her brother’s death and has a plan to become Matty’s mother...no matter who gets hurt in the process.

programs.title: Dragon Warriors
programs.desc: Dragons, warriors, orcs, bounty hunters, goblins, wizards, elves, witches, maidens in distress, beautiful princesses, romance, true love, betrayal and magic come together when an unlikely group of heroes embark on a quest to save the land from an evil wizard who has sent a fire-breathing dragon to kill everyone in his realm who has fallen in love.

programs.title: Dark Night of the Scarecrow
programs.desc: In a small Southern town, four vigilantes wrongfully execute a mentally-challenged man, but after the court sets them free, they begin to mysteriously experience deadly "accidents."

programs.title: Undercover Hooligan
programs.desc: From the creators of Rise of the Footsoldier - a suspended cop is sent undercover to infiltrate a notorious London criminal gang but struggles to keep his cover when he is dragged deeper and deeper into a world of failed operations, people trafficking, murder and extortion.

programs.title: The Sentinel
programs.desc: A fugitive Secret Service agent must clear himself of murdering a colleague.
